name: DataForSEO
description: DataForSEO provides pay-as-you-go REST APIs for SERP, keyword, backlink and other SEO data.
auth_notes: Basic HTTP authentication using the API login and password from the dashboard, Base64-encoded as login:password in the Authorization header.
gate_detail: Credentials come from the dashboard API Access page after signup. A free trial exists, but production use runs on pay-as-you-go pricing; the sources do not state trial limits or a minimum top-up.
api_scope: Covers SERP, keyword data, on-page, backlinks and other data APIs, with JSON responses, live and task-based methods, OpenAPI spec and official Python and TypeScript clients.
mcp_notes: The provided sources do not mention an MCP server.
blocker_detail: Usage is pay-as-you-go (monthly commitments cancelled); a free trial is mentioned but its terms are not given in the sources.

evidence.quote: Your DataForSEO API key is your API login and API password, joined as login:password and encoded in Base64.
Our API uses Basic HTTP authentication.
You take the API login and password from your dashboard, encode them in Base64 as login:password , and send the result in the Authorization header.
moving all endpoints to a pay-as-you-go model by cancelling monthly commitments.

issues: Trial limits and any minimum payment for production use are not stated.
No source mentions an MCP server.
Webhook support is inferred from a 'Webhooks & callbacks' help link.

searches.query: DataForSEO API credentials pricing plan required developer access
